passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Speak to the Israelites and tell them: I am the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD said these words to Moses.
The LORD told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
The LORD told Moses to say this to them.
The LORD said, “I am the LORD your God.”
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ דַּבֵּר֙ אֶל־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְאָמַרְתָּ֖ אֲלֵהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You must not follow the practices of the land of Egypt, where you used to live, and you must not follow the practices of the land of Canaan, into which I am bringing you. You must not walk in their customs.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the Israelites.
God said, "I am the LORD your God."
You lived in Egypt.
Do not do what the people of Egypt did.
I am bringing you to the land of Canaan.
Do not do what the people of Canaan do.
Do not follow their customs.
passages.original: כְּמַעֲשֵׂ֧ה אֶֽרֶץ־ מִצְרַ֛יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר יְשַׁבְתֶּם־ בָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֑וּ וּכְמַעֲשֵׂ֣ה אֶֽרֶץ־ כְּנַ֡עַן אֲשֶׁ֣ר אֲנִי֩ מֵבִ֨יא אֶתְכֶ֥ם שָׁ֙מָּה֙ לֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ וּבְחֻקֹּתֵיהֶ֖ם לֹ֥א תֵלֵֽכוּ׃

passages.text: You are to practice My judgments and keep My statutes by walking in them. I am the LORD your God.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD is the God of Israel.
The LORD gave judgments to Israel.
The LORD gave statutes to Israel.
Israel must do the LORD’s judgments.
Israel must keep the LORD’s statutes.
Israel must live by these judgments and statutes.
The LORD is their God.
passages.original: אֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֧י תַּעֲשׂ֛וּ וְאֶת־ חֻקֹּתַ֥י תִּשְׁמְר֖וּ לָלֶ֣כֶת בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Keep My statutes and My judgments, for the man who does these things will live by them. I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God gave statutes and judgments.
You must keep God's statutes.
You must keep God's judgments.
If a person does these statutes and judgments, that person will live by them.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֤ם אֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י אֲשֶׁ֨ר יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתָ֛ם הָאָדָ֖ם וָחַ֣י בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: None of you are to approach any close relative to have sexual relations. I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God is speaking.
God is the LORD.
God commands His people.
Do not approach any close relative for sexual relations.
I am the LORD.
passages.original: אִ֥ישׁ אִישׁ֙ אֶל־ כָּל־ שְׁאֵ֣ר בְּשָׂר֔וֹ לֹ֥א תִקְרְב֖וּ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָ֑ה אֲנִ֖י יְהוָֽה׃ס

passages.text: You must not expose the nakedness of your father by having sexual relations with your mother. She is your mother; you must not have sexual relations with her.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God commanded the people to obey His statutes and judgments.
God said, "I am the LORD."
God forbade sexual relations with close relatives.
God said, "Do not have sexual relations with your mother."
She is your mother.
Do not have sexual relations with her.
Do not dishonor your father by this act.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֛יךָ וְעֶרְוַ֥ת אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אִמְּךָ֣ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s wife; it would dishonor your father.
passages.sermon: God gave this command to the people of Israel.\r\nGod said, “Do not have sexual relations with your father’s wife.\r\nThis act would bring shame to your father.”
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־ אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your sister, either your father’s daughter or your mother’s daughter, whether she was born in the same home or elsewhere.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God forbids sexual relations with close family.
You must not have sexual relations with your sister.
Your sister may be your father’s daughter.
Your sister may be your mother’s daughter.
She may have been born in your home.
She may have been born elsewhere.
You must not have sexual relations with her.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת אֲחֽוֹתְךָ֤ בַת־ אָבִ֙יךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַת־ אִמֶּ֔ךָ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת בַּ֔יִת א֖וֹ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת ח֑וּץ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽן׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter or your daughter’s daughter, for that would shame your family.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God forbids certain sexual relations.
You must not have sexual relations with your son’s daughter.
You must not have sexual relations with your daughter’s daughter.
These actions would shame your family.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֤ת בַּת־ בִּנְךָ֙ א֣וֹ בַֽת־ בִּתְּךָ֔ לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָ֑ן כִּ֥י עֶרְוָתְךָ֖ הֵֽנָּה׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife, born to your father; she is your sister.
passages.sermon:
This command is for the people of Israel.
God gives these laws to protect families.
Do not have sexual relations with the daughter of your father’s wife.
She was born to your father.
She is your sister.
Do not dishonor her.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֨ת בַּת־ אֵ֤שֶׁת אָבִ֙יךָ֙ מוֹלֶ֣דֶת אָבִ֔יךָ אֲחוֹתְךָ֖ הִ֑וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister; she is your father’s close relative.
passages.sermon:
God gives this command.
You must not have sexual relations with your father’s sister.
She is your father’s close relative.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחוֹת־ אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה שְׁאֵ֥ר אָבִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister, for she is your mother’s close relative.
passages.sermon:
God gave this command to Israel.
God said, “Do not have sexual relations with your mother’s sister.”
Your mother’s sister is your close relative.
Do not dishonor her.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחֽוֹת־ אִמְּךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה כִּֽי־ שְׁאֵ֥ר אִמְּךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ס

passages.text: You must not dishonor your father’s brother by approaching his wife to have sexual relations with her; she is your aunt.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel about sexual relations.
God forbade certain relationships.
Your father’s brother is your uncle.
His wife is your aunt.
Do not approach your aunt for sexual relations.
Do not dishonor your uncle by doing this.
Your aunt is your uncle’s wife.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֲחִֽי־ אָבִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶל־ אִשְׁתּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א תִקְרָ֔ב דֹּדָֽתְךָ֖ הִֽוא׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law. She is your son’s wife; you are not to have sexual relations with her.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel about sexual relations.
God forbids certain relationships.
You must not have sexual relations with your daughter-in-law.
Your daughter-in-law is your son’s wife.
You must not have sexual relations with your son’s wife.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת כַּלָּֽתְךָ֖ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֵ֤שֶׁת בִּנְךָ֙ הִ֔וא לֹ֥א תְגַלֶּ֖ה עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife; that would shame your brother.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God forbids certain sexual relationships.
You must not have sexual relations with your brother’s wife.
She is your brother’s wife.
Having sexual relations with her would shame your brother.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אֵֽשֶׁת־ אָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה עֶרְוַ֥ת אָחִ֖יךָ הִֽוא׃ס

passages.text: You must not have sexual relations with both a woman and her daughter. You are not to marry her son’s daughter or her daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her. They are close relatives; it is depraved.
passages.sermon:
God gives laws about sexual relations.
God forbids certain relationships.
You must not have sexual relations with a woman and her daughter.
You must not marry a woman’s son’s daughter and have sexual relations with her.
You must not marry a woman’s daughter’s daughter and have sexual relations with her.
These women are close relatives.
Such actions are depraved.
passages.original: עֶרְוַ֥ת אִשָּׁ֛ה וּבִתָּ֖הּ לֹ֣א תְגַלֵּ֑ה אֶֽת־ בַּת־ בְּנָ֞הּ וְאֶת־ בַּת־ בִּתָּ֗הּ לֹ֤א תִקַּח֙ לְגַלּ֣וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֔הּ שַׁאֲרָ֥ה הֵ֖נָּה זִמָּ֥ה הִֽוא

passages.text: You must not take your wife’s sister as a rival wife and have sexual relations with her while your wife is still alive.
passages.sermon: God gave laws to Israel about marriage and sexual relations.\r\nGod said, do not take your wife's sister as a rival wife.\r\nDo not have sexual relations with your wife's sister while your wife is still alive.
passages.original: וְאִשָּׁ֥ה אֶל־ אֲחֹתָ֖הּ לֹ֣א תִקָּ֑ח לִצְרֹ֗ר לְגַלּ֧וֹת עֶרְוָתָ֛הּ עָלֶ֖יהָ בְּחַיֶּֽיהָ׃

passages.text: You must not approach a woman to have sexual relations with her during her menstrual period.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God commanded the people.
Do not approach a woman for sexual relations during her menstrual period.
Do not have sexual relations with her at that time.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ אִשָּׁ֖ה בְּנִדַּ֣ת טֻמְאָתָ֑הּ לֹ֣א תִקְרַ֔ב לְגַלּ֖וֹת עֶרְוָתָֽהּ׃

passages.text: You must not lie carnally with your neighbor’s wife and thus defile yourself with her.
passages.sermon: God gives this command to His people.\r\nGod says, “Do not have sexual relations with your neighbor’s wife.”\r\nIf you do this, you defile yourself with her.
passages.original: וְאֶל־ אֵ֙שֶׁת֙ עֲמִֽיתְךָ֔ לֹא־ תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ֖ לְזָ֑רַע לְטָמְאָה־ בָֽהּ׃

passages.text: You must not give any of your children to be sacrificed to Molech, for you must not profane the name of your God. I am the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to His people.
God commands them.
Do not give any of your children to Molech.
Do not sacrifice your children to this false god.
If you do this, you profane the name of your God.
I am the LORD.
passages.original: וּמִֽזַּרְעֲךָ֥ לֹא־ תִתֵּ֖ן לְהַעֲבִ֣יר לַמֹּ֑לֶךְ וְלֹ֧א תְחַלֵּ֛ל אֶת־ שֵׁ֥ם אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ אֲנִ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: You must not lie with a man as with a woman; that is an abomination.
passages.sermon: God gave this command to Israel.\r\nGod said, “Do not lie with a man as you lie with a woman.\r\nThis act is an abomination.”
passages.original: וְאֶ֨ת־ זָכָ֔ר לֹ֥א תִשְׁכַּ֖ב מִשְׁכְּבֵ֣י אִשָּׁ֑ה תּוֹעֵבָ֖ה הִֽוא׃

passages.text: You must not lie carnally with any animal, thus defiling yourself with it; a woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it; that is a perversion.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God commanded the people.
Do not have sexual relations with any animal.
If you do, you make yourself unclean.
A woman must not stand before an animal to mate with it.
This is a perversion.
passages.original: וּבְכָל־ בְּהֵמָ֛ה לֹא־ תִתֵּ֥ן שְׁכָבְתְּךָ֖ לְטָמְאָה־ בָ֑הּ וְאִשָּׁ֗ה לֹֽא־ תַעֲמֹ֞ד לִפְנֵ֧י בְהֵמָ֛ה לְרִבְעָ֖הּ תֶּ֥בֶל הֽוּא׃

passages.text: Do not defile yourselves by any of these practices, for by all these things the nations I am driving out before you have defiled themselves.
passages.sermon:
God speaks to the people of Israel.
God commands them.
Do not make yourselves unclean by any of these practices.
The nations who lived in the land before you did all these things.
They became unclean because of these practices.
I am driving out those nations from before you.
passages.original: אַל־ תִּֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בְּכָל־ אֵ֑לֶּה כִּ֤י בְכָל־ אֵ֙לֶּה֙ נִטְמְא֣וּ הַגּוֹיִ֔ם אֲשֶׁר־ אֲנִ֥י מְשַׁלֵּ֖חַ מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Even the land has become defiled, so I am punishing it for its sin, and the land will vomit out its inhabitants.
passages.sermon: The land has become defiled.\r\nI am punishing the land for its sin.\r\nThe land will vomit out its inhabitants.
passages.original: וַתִּטְמָ֣א הָאָ֔רֶץ וָאֶפְקֹ֥ד עֲוֺנָ֖הּ עָלֶ֑יהָ וַתָּקִ֥א הָאָ֖רֶץ אֶת־ יֹשְׁבֶֽיהָ׃

passages.text: But you are to keep My statutes and ordinances, and you must not commit any of these abominations—neither your native-born nor the foreigner who lives among you.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws and rules to His people.
God commanded the Israelites to obey His statutes and ordinances.
God told them not to do any of the abominable practices.
God said both native-born Israelites and foreigners living among them must obey these commands.
No one among you may commit these abominations.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אַתֶּ֗ם אֶת־ חֻקֹּתַי֙ וְאֶת־ מִשְׁפָּטַ֔י וְלֹ֣א תַעֲשׂ֔וּ מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֖ת הָאֵ֑לֶּה הָֽאֶזְרָ֔ח וְהַגֵּ֖ר הַגָּ֥ר בְּתוֹכְכֶֽם׃

passages.text: For the men who were in the land before you committed all these abominations, and the land has become defiled.
passages.sermon:
The people who lived in this land before you did many evil things.
They committed all these abominations.
They defiled the land.
Now the land has become unclean.
passages.original: כִּ֚י אֶת־ כָּל־ הַתּוֹעֵבֹ֣ת הָאֵ֔ל עָשׂ֥וּ אַנְשֵֽׁי־ הָאָ֖רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לִפְנֵיכֶ֑ם וַתִּטְמָ֖א הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: So if you defile the land, it will vomit you out as it spewed out the nations before you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to the people of Israel.
God is holy.
God commanded the people to be holy.
God gave laws and rules to the people.
God told the people to obey His laws and rules.
God warned the people not to do evil acts.
God said, “Do not make the land unclean.”
If you make the land unclean, the land will force you out.
The land forced out the nations who lived there before you because they did evil acts.
If you do the same, the land will force you out too.
passages.original: וְלֹֽא־ תָקִ֤יא הָאָ֙רֶץ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם בְּטַֽמַּאֲכֶ֖ם אֹתָ֑הּ כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר קָאָ֛ה אֶת־ הַגּ֖וֹי אֲשֶׁ֥ר לִפְנֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Therefore anyone who commits any of these abominations must be cut off from among his people.
passages.sermon:
God gave laws to Israel.
God warned Israel about abominations.
Anyone who does any of these abominations commits a serious sin.
God commands that person must be cut off from his people.
God requires Israel to remove those who do these acts.
passages.original: כִּ֚י כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יַעֲשֶׂ֔ה מִכֹּ֥ל הַתּוֹעֵב֖וֹת הָאֵ֑לֶּה וְנִכְרְת֛וּ הַנְּפָשׁ֥וֹת הָעֹשֹׂ֖ת מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמָּֽם׃

passages.text: You must keep My charge not to practice any of the abominable customs that were practiced before you, so that you do not defile yourselves by them. I am the LORD your God.”
passages.sermon:
God is the LORD.
God is your God.
God commands you to obey Him.
Do not follow evil customs.
People before you did these evil customs.
Do not do what they did.
Do not make yourselves unclean by these customs.
Obey God’s command.
passages.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּ֣ם אֶת־ מִשְׁמַרְתִּ֗י לְבִלְתִּ֨י עֲשׂ֜וֹת מֵחֻקּ֤וֹת הַתּֽוֹעֵבֹת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר נַעֲשׂ֣וּ לִפְנֵיכֶ֔ם וְלֹ֥א תִֽטַּמְּא֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם אֲנִ֖י יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃פ
